Title: Saved carts lose their items after the shopper signs in on a second device

Description:
A shopper who filled a cart on their phone and signs in on a laptop finds the cart empty: the cart saved on the server replaces whatever the second device holds, and the device's items are lost.

Comments (latest 4 of 4):
- [Mara Quill] Prove: the new test fails on the base (cart had 0 items, expected 3) and passes on the branch.
- [builder] Handoff: carts now merge on sign-in. The wishlist used the same replace rule, so it now uses the cart merge too.
- [checks] Tests: 408 passed, 2 failed: wishlist keeps items after sign-out; wishlist count badge updates on merge.
- [reviewer] Verdict: approve the cart merge.
</untrusted-a1>
